description: Estimate the compulsory annual study or training loan repayment (HELP, HECS, VSL, SFSS, SSL, AASL) for an Australian resident from their repayment income, using the marginal system introduced in 2025-26 with effective-dated thresholds that roll over each financial year. Use it for "how much HELP/HECS will I repay" questions in AU; it does not cover the loan balance, indexation or voluntary repayments, and applies to Australia only. Repayment income is broader than taxable income — it adds back reportable super contributions, reportable fringe benefits, net investment loss and exempt foreign income; pass that combined figure. Results may include one sourced background fact (relatedFact); the figures do not depend on it.

repaymentIncome.description: ATO repayment income in AUD (taxable income + reportable super + reportable fringe benefits + net investment loss + exempt foreign income)

taxYear.description: Financial-year label like '2025-26'; omit to use the current Australian financial year

name: student_loan_repayment

country.description: Always AU — this tool is Australia-only

disclaimer.description: General-information note that must accompany any figure shown to a person

effectiveRate.description: repayment ÷ repayment income, as a fraction

mayBeStale.description: True once the verification date is over a year old — re-confirm with the authority

minThreshold.description: Income at or below which the repayment is nil (AUD)

kind.description: 'origin' = when the tax began and what it replaced; 'anniversary' = the same, on the anniversary of its start date; 'story' = a dated story from the facts corpus
